environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule at priority 200 that applies a regex pattern set matching UNION|SELECT|INSERT|DROP|--|;|'|%27 against query string values with action BLOCK and a custom 403 response body, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 in BLOCK mode as defense-in-depth. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to a GuardDuty-monitored S3 bucket but this is detective only.

config.runtime: Python 3.11, Flask 3.0.0, gunicorn on ECS Fargate
config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
